title: Tin Top Hall, Kenny's Hall (Funky Butt) and Perdido Street halls
summary: Dawson identifies Tin Top as a small hall on Perdido with a tin roof, nearby Kenny's Hall called the Funky Butt, and the Zulu Club.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
